description: Prepare wrapping Fables receipts into a position: every Fables receipt the wallet holds of one range (rangeId, gage_lp_positions fablesReceipts) becomes one position NFT the LP lane lends against: staked receipts are unstaked first (they stop earning Fables' emissions), and the wrapped ones earn the pool's swap fees. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

adapter.description: The lane's Fables adapter (gage_capabilities lpLane.adapters, kind fables)

rangeId.description: A Fables range's id: the receipts gage_lp_positions lists under fablesReceipts

name: gage_prepare_lp_wrap
title: Prepare: Wrap Fables receipts into a position
